title: Scroll Back
blurb: Phones, games, space and sports since 2000. Three facts per card are real, one is cap.

cards.say: YouTube [had a clip filmed at a zoo as its very first video], [was founded before Voyager 1 reached interstellar space], [got its first video with a billion views in 2012], and [was bought by Google in 2010, five years after it started].
cards.real: Google bought YouTube in 2006 for 1.65 billion dollars, less than two years after the site started in 2005.

cards.say: Minecraft [came out before the very first version of Roblox], [started out as a test version called Cave Game], [got its creeper from a mistake while making a pig], and [was bought by Microsoft, along with its maker, for 2.5 billion dollars].
cards.real: Roblox launched in 2006. Minecraft's first public test version didn't come out until 2009.

cards.say: Wordle [started as a gift from a software engineer to his partner], [had only 90 players at the start of November 2021], [was bought by the New York Times for about 100 million dollars], and [got the idea for its emoji share grid from friends in New Zealand].
cards.real: The New York Times bought Wordle in January 2022 for a price in the low seven figures, meaning a few million dollars.

cards.say: The Wii [was code-named Revolution before it got its real name], [could play DVD movies right out of the box], [came with Wii Sports in the box in America], and [could play GameCube games when it first came out].
cards.real: The Wii couldn't play DVD movies or music CDs at all. Its disc drive only took game discs.

cards.say: The first iPhone [came with the App Store already built in], [had no way to copy and paste text], [had no front camera for taking selfies], and [came out more than a year before Spotify launched].
cards.real: The first iPhone came out in June 2007 with no App Store. The App Store opened a year later, in July 2008.

cards.say: Ingenuity, the Mars helicopter, [made the first powered flight on another planet, in 2021], [carried a scrap of fabric from the Wright brothers' first plane], [flew 72 times after being built for just five test flights], and [rode to Mars tucked under the belly of the Curiosity rover].
cards.real: Ingenuity rode to Mars strapped under NASA's Perseverance rover, which landed in 2021. Curiosity had landed back in 2012.

cards.say: New Horizons [set off for Pluto months before Pluto was demoted to a dwarf planet], [found out up close that Pluto has no moons at all], [flew for about nine and a half years to reach Pluto], and [sent home pictures of a giant heart shape on Pluto].
cards.real: Pluto has five known moons, including a big one named Charon. New Horizons flew past Pluto and its moons in 2015.
src: NOT WEB-CHECKED (textbook) New Horizons' July 2015 flyby photographed the heart-shaped region later named Tombaugh Regio https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Horizons

cards.say: Michael Phelps [won eight gold medals at a single Olympics in 2008], [goes by the nickname the Flying Fish], [won more than 30 Olympic medals in all], and [won 23 Olympic gold medals in his career].
cards.real: Phelps won 28 Olympic medals in all: 23 gold, 3 silver and 2 bronze.

cards.say: Usain Bolt [ran a world record 100 meters at the 2008 Olympics with a shoelace untied], [set a world record of 9.58 seconds for 100 meters in 2009], [played cricket and soccer in the street as a kid], and [won his first Olympic gold medal at the 2004 Olympics].
cards.real: At his first Olympics, in Athens in 2004, Bolt was hurt and went out in the first round of the 200 meters. His first golds came in 2008.

cards.say: The James Webb Space Telescope [launched into space on Christmas Day 2021], [has a sunshield about the size of a tennis court], [orbits Earth just a little higher than the space station], and [cost about 10 billion dollars to build].
cards.real: Webb works nearly a million miles from Earth, thousands of times farther out than the space station.

cards.say: The Tokyo 2020 Olympics [were the first Olympics ever held in Japan], [took place in 2021 but kept the name Tokyo 2020], [gave out medals made from metal in donated old phones], and [had two 13-year-olds win gold and silver in skateboarding].
cards.real: They were the fourth Olympics in Japan. Tokyo also hosted in 1964, and Japan held Winter Games in Sapporo in 1972 and Nagano in 1998.

cards.say: The Curiosity rover [played Happy Birthday to itself on Mars in 2013], [runs on electricity from big solar panels], [leaves the letters JPL in Morse code in its wheel tracks], and [was lowered onto Mars on cables from a hovering rocket crane].
cards.real: Curiosity runs on a nuclear battery, not solar panels. It landed in Gale Crater on Mars in August 2012.
